notes.title: LUXIS Launches for Linux
notes.content:
Hello all!

LUXIS has launched for Linux today. The game was tested on Ubuntu and Linux Mint with an Xbox controller, but should work with all Linux distros and comparable controllers. If any issues arise please post in the Community page or contact me directly here http://www.dumbfoundedproductions.com/join_us.

If any customers have a problem running the game I will get on resolving the issue as soon as I can.

The next big update of the game will feature some audio fixes, new music, minor graphics fixes, a new bonus level in preparation for a new set of 10 levels coming in another future update.

Happy gaming!

--Kris

Note for all users: If you are playing on a low-end machine and getting some frame drops, set the refresh rate to 30hz in the settings menu

notes.title: OSX Build of Game Should Now Be Working
notes.content:
So much for a smooth launch, huh? 

After a bit of hair pulling out, and frantically seeking a solution to the issue with Mac versions of LUXIS not properly downloading, I think I have solved the issue. Everything should be downloading fine, there is still a minor bug at the start of the game on Mac, just click the screen to start the game if it doesn't start automatically. This will be addressed in the next update.

Sorry for any inconvenience this may have caused anyone, and please contact me if any more issues arise. 

Happy gaming!

--Kris

notes.title: All Achievements Now Working (UPDATE)
notes.content:
TYPOS!!!!!

Hello all,

It was brought to my attention that a couple of achievements weren't working, completely the fault of a couple of typos on my end. I have just updated the game and all achievements should now be working. If you don't have auto-updates enabled you will have to update the game.

If anyone has more trouble with these or anything else, please post on the community page and I will take a look at the issue and begin work to get it resolved as quickly as possible.

Sorry for any inconvenience and happy gaming!

P.S. I am beginning work on new levels which will be added to the game, 1 more to start, then another set of 10.

--Kris

notes.title: Mac Game Controller and Known Issues
notes.content:
Hello all,

While LUXIS seems to be running fine on OSX, the game does pause when you start it. Click the screen with the mouse, and all should run smoothly after that. I will try to track the culprit and fix this in a future update.

LUXIS is developed for XInput controllers, so Mac users will need to have an XBOX controller (or equivalent XInput controller) and have the latest XBOX controller drivers installed. 

Happy gaming!!
